biological_interpretation: CHD2 perturbation has a thalamic RNA-processing/ion-channel output distinct from other CHD-family chromatin remodelers.
caveats: The Chd2 mRNA itself was not detectably depleted, and 217 P MY Pineal Glut had only 34 perturbed cells.
Chd2 had weak measured target engagement; the contrast establishes non-phenocopying in this assay but not necessarily biochemical independence.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Chd2 produced its stringent response in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, with Ddx5, Snrnp70, Sf3b1, Snrpn, Kcnc2, Kcnj9, Kcnt1, P2rx4, Tmem38a, and Tmem63b nominating RNA-processing and excitability outputs; the same thalamic signature did not phenocopy Chd4, Chd7, or Chd8. Parquet-verified leading rows: Chd2->Snhg11 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.26, FDR 7.39e-18; Chd2->Plekhg1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.438, FDR 3.60e-13; Chd2->Ptpn3 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.381, FDR 6.66e-09; Chd2->Ddx5 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.311, FDR 6.06e-06; Chd2->Kcnc2 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -0.223, FDR 1.91e-04; Chd2->Igsf8 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC 0.382, FDR 0.0018.

finding_summaries.summary: The stringent Chd2 response is concentrated in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut rather than being a broad pan-neuronal phenotype.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: This localizes the strongest observed consequence of a CHD2-family neurodevelopmental-disorder gene to a thalamic glutamatergic state in this dataset, extending literature that has emphasized cortical and GABAergic interneuron development.

finding_summaries.summary: Chd2 did not phenocopy Chd4, Chd7, or Chd8 in the responsive thalamic glutamatergic class.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: Broad CHD-family membership was a poor predictor of the Chd2 signature in this cell state, consistent with curated separation of CHD subfamilies rather than interchangeability among CHD-family ATPases.

resolved_evidence.description: The thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic class carried the largest stringent Chd2-associated expression response.
resolved_evidence.statistics: 153 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; 34 genes at FDR<0.05 and 42 at FDR<0.10. Top FDR genes included Snhg11 logFC=-0.260 FDR=7.39e-18, Plekhg1 -0.438 FDR=3.60e-13, Ptpn3 -0.381 FDR=6.66e-09, Ddx5 -0.311 FDR=6.06e-06.

resolved_evidence.description: Other assayed CHD-family perturbations were active in the same cell class but did not phenocopy the Chd2 transcriptomic signature.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Against the Chd2 score vector over 17,259 shared genes, correlations were Chd4 r=-0.005, Chd8 r=-0.003, and Chd7 r=0.057. FDR<0.05 overlaps with the 34 Chd2 genes were 2 genes for Chd4 and 2 genes for Chd8; Chd4, Chd8, and Chd7 had 100, 61, and 0 FDR genes respectively. Chd8 showed on-target Chd8 logFC=-0.532 FDR=1.02e-09, whereas Chd2 showed Chd2 logFC=-0.052 FDR=1.0.

title: CHD2 loss rewires RNA-processing and ion-channel transcripts in TH Prkcd/Grin2c neurons without phenocopying CHD4, CHD7, or CHD8
